sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: 17GB VRAM, Benchmarks, Ollama Setup
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-27B is Alibaba Qwen team's dense 27-billion-parameter coding-and-reasoning model released April 22, 2026. It's notable for one reason: it beats Alibaba's own much larger Qwen3.5-Plus 397B MoE model on agentic coding benchmarks.
